rejection.code_malformed: "{field}" is not a valid code. Use letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores.
rejection.date_malformed: {field} is not a date. Use the form YYYY-MM-DD.
rejection.metadata_entry_too_long: The metadata entry "{key}" is too long.
rejection.document_reference_malformed: That is not a valid document reference.
rejection.employment_number_malformed: That is not an employment number this system issued. Employment numbers are generated and cannot be supplied.
rejection.hire_after_start: The original hire date cannot be after the employment start date.
rejection.start_date_is_in_force: This employment has already started, so its start date can no longer be corrected. Record the change that actually happened instead.
rejection.employment_ended: This employment has ended and can no longer be changed.
rejection.transition_not_permitted: An employment cannot move from {from} to {to}.
rejection.ending_needs_a_date_and_a_reason: Ending an employment needs an end date and a reason. Use the end operation.
rejection.end_before_start: An employment cannot end before it began.
rejection.person_merged: This person's record has been merged into another. Create the employment against the surviving record.
rejection.person_already_employed: This person already has an employment that has not ended.
rejection.fte_out_of_range: A full-time equivalent must be more than zero and no more than one. Somebody working more than full time holds a second assignment.
rejection.primary_assignment_already_in_force: This employment already has a primary assignment in force on that date.
rejection.no_primary_assignment_to_change: This employment has no primary assignment to change. Create one first.
rejection.manager_cannot_be_self: An employment cannot report to itself.
rejection.manager_employment_ended: That manager's own employment has ended.
rejection.reporting_line_would_close_a_loop: That change would make two employments report to each other.
rejection.contract_ends_before_it_begins: A contract cannot end before it begins.
rejection.probation_ends_before_contract_begins: A probation cannot end before the contract begins.
rejection.contract_has_no_probation: This contract records no probation period.
rejection.probation_already_concluded: This probation has already been concluded.
rejection.notice_period_out_of_range: That notice period is not a plausible number of days.
rejection.working_hours_out_of_range: That is not a plausible number of working hours in a week.
rejection.import_too_large: That import has more rows than a single request accepts.
rejection.export_too_large: This workforce is too large for a synchronous export.

label.unavailable: The workforce could not be read. Sign-in is not available yet.

boundary.leave: Leave status belongs to the Leave domain, not to an employment's status.
boundary.payroll: No salary, no payroll figure and no attendance: Employment holds the relationship only.
boundary.location: Work location is not modelled: a unit and a physical place of work are different things, and no authoritative model of the second exists yet.
boundary.offboarding: Ending an employment records its final state. Exit interviews, clearance and final settlement belong to Offboarding.
